title: thymophylla setifolia var. radiata
intro: Thymophylla setifolia var. radiata, commonly known as desert marigold, is a plant species native to the southwestern United States and Mexico. It has been traditionally used for its medicinal properties, which include a range of health benefits such as anti-inflammatory, antimicrobial, and antioxidant effects. The therapeutic actions of desert marigold include wound healing, immune system support, and the treatment of various gastrointestinal issues. The bioactive constituents of Thymophylla setifolia var. radiata include sesquiterpene lactones, flavonoids, and phenolic acids, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
